provenance.title: Common layout patterns
provenance.covers: Simple placement habits for a room: where the head of a bed should not be, and which pieces are normally pushed against a wall. Common habits, our own words.

sources.name: Approved Document M: Access to and use of buildings (UK government). Listed as a place to check against. It was not opened.

rules.note: Typical guideline, check local rules. A bed should not have its head under a window. A bed against a wall that has a window along it counts as under the window.
Typical guideline, check local rules. These pieces are normally placed against a wall, so a new spot for them is looked for along the walls.
